title: GATTA: Graph Active Learning with Test-Time Augmentation
abstract: arXiv:2608.15084v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Test-time augmentation (TTA) has proven effective for improving model robustness and uncertainty estimation in computer vision, yet its application to graph-structured data remains largely unexplored. We introduce GATTA (Graph Active Learning with Test-Time Augmentation), a framework for enhancing active learning by aggregating predictions across multiple augmented views to produce more reliable uncertainty estimates. To address the challenge of label-preserving graph augmentations, GATTA incorporates a consistency-based filtering mechanism that discards augmented views yielding unreliable predictions. We systematically evaluate GATTA across multiple graph datasets, GNN architectures, and acquisition strategies. Our results show that simple uncertainty-based methods, such as Entropy and Least Confidence, benefit most from TTA, achieving performance competitive with more sophisticated and computationally expensive approaches. translated_title: GATTA：基于测试时增强的图主动学习
translated_abstract: 测试时增强（TTA）已被证明能有效提高计算机视觉中模型的鲁棒性和不确定性估计，但其在图结构数据上的应用仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了GATTA（基于测试时增强的图主动学习），这是一种通过聚合多个增强视图的预测来产生更可靠的不确定性估计，从而增强主动学习的框架。为了解决保持标签的图增强这一挑战，GATTA引入了一种基于一致性的过滤机制，丢弃产生不可靠预测的增强视图。我们在多个图数据集、GNN架构和采集策略上系统评估了GATTA。结果表明，像熵和最小置信度这类简单的不确定性方法从TTA中获益最多，其性能可与更复杂且计算成本更高的方法相媲美。
tldr: GATTA通过测试时增强和一致性过滤机制，显著提升了图主动学习中简单不确定性方法的表现，使其达到与复杂方法相当的性能。
en_tdlr: GATTA enhances simple uncertainty-based methods in graph active learning through test-time augmentation and consistency filtering, achieving performance comparable to sophisticated approaches.
